cases.name: prototype-case-soft
cases.notes: Prototype clues, all soft. Crimson Monarch's streak is six, so no horse fits all four.

clues.description: Won at least seven consecutive races
Lost immediately after the seven-win streak

cases.name: prototype-case-hard-streaks
cases.notes: Same clues with the streak facts as hard constraints.

clues.description: Won at least seven consecutive races
Lost immediately after the seven-win streak

cases.name: kentucky-monarch-no-date
cases.notes: Without the date clue, horses with no recorded titles cannot be ruled out.

cases.name: unbeaten-victorian
cases.notes: Tests inference from a career summary with no race order.

clues.description: Never beaten in at least 20 starts

cases.name: long-streak-sparse-data
cases.notes: Harbor Lantern has 9 wins but no race order, so it stays unresolved rather than penalized.

clues.description: Won at least eight in a row

cases.name: irish-traveller
cases.notes: Tests counts derived from a complete race list and international status derived from venues.

cases.name: nickname-word-boundary
cases.notes: 'Arrow' matches 'The Golden Arrow'; 'Arr' must not match anything.

cases.name: race-records-derived-career
cases.notes: Copper Wren has only race records. Its five-race streak counts a walkover and a dead heat for first as wins, passes over a void race that is not a start, and ends when it is disqualified from first. Starts, wins, and racing abroad come from the complete race list.

clues.description: Lost directly after the five-race streak

cases.name: partial-race-list-abroad
cases.notes: Juniper Vale's race list is partial, but one listed race in GB shows that it raced abroad.

cases.name: partial-race-list-streak-unknown
cases.notes: Juniper Vale's partial race list has no two wins in a row. The list is not complete, so the streak stays unknown and the hard clue does not eliminate it.

clues.description: Won at least two in a row

cases.name: won-at-age-4-either-birthday
cases.notes: Wattle Crown won the Harwell Cup in GB in May 1987. It is 3 under the AUS birthday and 4 under the GB birthday, and either age fitting is enough.

cases.name: lost-first-start-abroad
cases.notes: Marram Grey lost its first start abroad. Copper Wren and Wattle Crown won theirs.

clues.description: Lost on its first start abroad

cases.name: unbeaten-at-g1
cases.notes: Marram Grey won both Group 1 starts, published as "Group 1" and "G1". Copper Wren and Wattle Crown each lost at that level.

cases.name: won-all-contradicted-by-partial-list
cases.notes: Juniper Vale's race list is partial, but it includes a Group 3 loss, which is enough to contradict unbeaten at that level.

cases.name: first-unknown-on-partial-list
cases.notes: Juniper Vale's first recorded start abroad was a loss, but the list is partial, so an earlier start abroad may be missing.

clues.description: Lost on its first start abroad

cases.name: title-proven-from-races
cases.notes: Wattle Crown has no title list, but its race records show it won the Coolah Cup. Copper Wren has no record of that race and is not ruled out.
